部屋 retains ordinary room and housing apartment senses plus qualified sumo stable mention. Native irregularへや is not regularon+onぶや; source mnemonic is not invented kanji history.

Canonicalいす retains kanji:[] andkango type despite usual椅子 spelling in body; no invented椅子runtime alias. Modern katakanaイス does not prove a modern European origin; captured figurative office/post sense not added.

戸 door sense and contextual shutter comparison in窓 retained. Door sense is restricted to戸 spelling in capture; archaic entrance/narrows and JMnedictplace material not adopted. ドア is not restricted to hinged doors.
机 and テーブル usage distinction is not an absolute height/drawer rule. Their actual Russian desk/table meanings require direct-pair assessment, not all-furniture exclusions.

電気 retains electricity and electric-light senses; mnemonic電+気electric-energy is labelled mnemonic, not history. 電話 retains device/call/する scopes and all source direct distractors; 電車 retains electric-rail meaning rather than a commuter-only rule.

箱 adopts container sense and source本箱 lexicalized bookcase contrast, not colloquial building/train/shamisen/archaic/counter senses from complete capture. 庭 adopts garden/yard/courtyard, not an automatic flower garden or the unrelated action-field sense.
